card.name: Words just before gut anatomy terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'the', 'and', 'beyond' or 'in the' right before a gut-related term (jejunum, gastric antrum, ampulla) in GI procedure or diagnostic-test text. Also 'breath' in 'breath test'.

modes.label: Linking word before gut site
modes.description: 'the' or 'and' or 'beyond' placed just before a named part of the digestive tract.
